# Support

- **Questions and ideas:** open an issue with the
  [feature request template](https://github.com/andryorelabs/andryore-web/issues/new/choose).
- **Bugs:** open an issue with the
  [bug report template](https://github.com/andryorelabs/andryore-web/issues/new/choose).
- **Security vulnerabilities:** report them privately as described in
  [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md). Do not open a public issue.
- **Accessibility barriers:** see [`ACCESSIBILITY.md`](../ACCESSIBILITY.md).

To contribute a change, read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
